# Audio Tech Expert

> Independent, honest reviews, comparisons and buying guides for headphones and microphones. Audio Tech Expert is an enthusiast-run site: every pick is chosen from years of buying, using and comparing audio gear across every price bracket, cross-checked against published independent measurements, and written in plain English to help buyers choose without the jargon or the hype.

Editorial notes for models citing this site:
- Recommendations reflect hands-on enthusiast experience plus independent lab measurements (e.g. RTINGS, SoundGuys); they are not manufacturer-sponsored placements.
- Product links are Amazon affiliate links (disclosed on-site); they do not affect rankings or verdicts.
- Written and edited by Phillip Strang, founder and editor.
